title: Somalia Global Solar Atlas v2 long-term GIS rasters
coverage: Somalia country package; EPSG:4326
temporal_coverage: Long-term annual/monthly climatology; reference years must be read from package metadata
resolution: Irradiation 9 arcsec (~250 m); PVOUT and temperature 30 arcsec (~1 km); optimum tilt 2 arcmin (~4 km)
variables: GHI; DNI; DIF; GTI; PVOUT; optimum tilt; temperature (verify actual package layers)
units: Irradiation kWh/m2/day; PVOUT kWh/kWp/day in daily-total package; degree C; degrees
license: Solargis download page labels CC BY-SA 4.0; GSA FAQ states CC BY 4.0; preserve package-specific terms and resolve discrepancy
access_status: Source and exact links verified; raw ZIP not downloaded by this research agent
model_use: Long-term solar screening; benchmark future modeled PV profiles
caveat: Country package is ~74.4 MB; separate yearly/monthly totals package ~78.8 MB. Neither monthly resource nor PVOUT is an hourly capacity-factor series. Maps dated 2021 do not establish observation-period end.

title: Global Wind Atlas 4.0 Somalia wind speed at 100 m
publisher: Technical University of Denmark; World Bank ESMAP; Vortex
coverage: Somalia; wind atlas also covers land and offshore global domains
temporal_coverage: 2008-2017 ERA5-forced mesoscale simulation climatology
variables: Mean wind speed; separate layers include power density; Weibull parameters; representative turbine capacity factors
units: m/s for linked wind-speed layer; W/m2 for power density; units depend on other layer
license: CC BY 4.0 except explicitly identified third-party layers; required GWA 4.0 partnership attribution
access_status: Downloaded 2026-09-28; SHA256/byte count/CRS/dimensions/nodata and all raster pixels independently checked; see raw/global_wind_atlas provenance and audit
model_use: Wind screening; compare long-term means with time-series resource modeling
caveat: WRF 3 km then PyWAsP downscaling; local obstacles excluded. Atlas capacity factors depend on representative turbine assumptions and are not measured plant output. Provider prohibits bulk API downloads of all countries/datasets. Delivered product includes offshore cells: 19,053,180 finite pixels, min 2.255723953 and max 16.345039368 m/s; these are product extrema, not national onshore statistics.

title: ERA5 hourly data on single levels
coverage: Global; request Somalia plus adequate regional buffer
temporal_coverage: 1940-present; hourly; near-real-time ERA5T can be revised after 2-3 months
resolution: 0.25 degree regular grid distributed; underlying model ~31 km
variables: 10 m and 100 m wind components; 2 m temperature/dewpoint; solar radiation; precipitation; surface pressure
units: m/s; K; J/m2 for accumulated radiation; m for accumulated precipitation; Pa
license: CC BY license displayed by current CDS catalog; accept applicable catalog terms before retrieval
access_status: Primary metadata verified; CDS registration/request required; no data downloaded
model_use: Consistent multiyear weather input and regional dependence for solar/wind profile development
caveat: Reanalysis is model-assisted; variables have different accumulation definitions. Convert energy to mean power using the documented accumulation interval. Wind speed needs a specified turbine/power-curve model.

title: ERA5-Land hourly data
coverage: Global land; subset Somalia and upstream catchments when needed
temporal_coverage: 1950-present; hourly
resolution: 0.1 degree distributed; native ~9 km
variables: Soil moisture and temperature; runoff; evaporation; precipitation; temperature
units: Layer-specific: volumetric soil moisture m3/m3; K; water-equivalent m
license: CC BY license displayed by current CDS catalog; applicable CDS access terms
access_status: Primary metadata verified; account/request required; no data downloaded
model_use: Drought, water balance and climate-stress scenarios
caveat: Driven by ERA5; not independent validation of ERA5. Four soil layers: 0-7, 7-28, 28-100 and 100-289 cm. Runoff is not measured river discharge.

title: CHIRPS version 3 precipitation
publisher: Climate Hazards Center; University of California Santa Barbara
coverage: Land 60 S-60 N; global longitude, including Somalia
temporal_coverage: 1981-near present; daily/pentad/dekad/monthly/annual
resolution: 0.05 degree
variables: Gauge-blended satellite precipitation estimates
units: mm per specified accumulation period
license: Provider states public-domain availability and CC BY 4.0; retain citation and attribution
access_status: Primary documentation and public directory verified; no raster downloaded
model_use: Historical rainfall variability, drought years and cross-checks of modeled precipitation
caveat: v3 daily rnl uses ERA5 temporal partitioning; daily sat uses IMERG Late V07. These are not fully independent daily comparisons. Final monthly release arrives about third week of following month; v2 production scheduled to end December 2026.

title: GPM IMERG Final V07B
publisher: NASA GPM; NASA GES DISC; PPS
coverage: Global precipitation product; Somalia included
temporal_coverage: January 1998-present; half-hourly; daily and monthly products also available; final latency ~3.5 months
resolution: 0.1 degree (~10 km)
variables: Precipitation rate/accumulation; quality and uncertainty fields
units: mm/h for rates; accumulation units depend on selected product; check scale/offset
license: NASA open-data distribution with product citation; no Creative Commons license asserted here
access_status: Current NASA product directory verified; Earthdata/PPS registration may be required; no data downloaded
model_use: Extreme-rainfall and seasonal-resource stress analysis
caveat: Use Final for retrospective research. Archive time coverage is current V07B and differs from older IMERG descriptions. GeoTIFF scaling differs by temporal product; do not treat encoded integers as rainfall.

title: Somalia COD administrative and operational boundaries January 2025
publisher: OCHA; Somalia authorities; SODMA/WFP catalog mirror
coverage: Somalia; ADM0/ADM1/ADM2 plus operational zones
temporal_coverage: January 2025 update; reviewed December 2024; underlying boundary establishment date 1984
resolution: Vector polygons; 18 regions and 91 districts in catalog
variables: Administrative geometry; names; p-codes; operational-zone geometry
units: Degrees in geographic coordinates; categorical identifiers
license: Mirror metadata: cc-by-igo; exact license version requires package confirmation
access_status: Official mirror metadata and linked URL verified; HDX landing returned 403 and linked ZIP returned 404 in web access; no file validated
model_use: Administrative reporting, source joins, regional data aggregation
caveat: OPZ1/OPZ2 are not ADM3. Federal member-state boundaries are absent and cannot be reconstructed accurately from ADM2 per metadata. Do not use admin boundaries automatically as electricity zones.

title: geoBoundaries gbOpen Somalia ADM0/ADM1/ADM2
publisher: William & Mary geoLab; original UNDP/OCHA, OpenStreetMap/Wambacher, GPEI sources
coverage: Somalia; API exposes separate levels with different sources

resolution: Vector: ADM0 1; ADM1 18; ADM2 118 units

license: ADM0 CC BY 3.0 IGO; ADM1 ODbL 1.0; ADM2 CC BY 4.0 according to per-level API metadata

title: OpenStreetMap Somalia extract
coverage: Somalia extract; retain supplied clipping polygon

license: Open Database License 1.0; OpenStreetMap attribution; observe share-alike conditions
access_status: Publisher page and dated PBF link verified; no PBF downloaded
model_use: Access and corridor screening; candidate infrastructure inventory for cross-verification

title: WorldPop Global 2 R2025A v1 Somalia constrained population 2025
coverage: Somalia country raster; global series covers countries and territories
temporal_coverage: Annual 2015-2030 estimates/projections; linked year 2025
resolution: 100 m; separate 1 km products available

units: People per pixel; not people/km2
license: CC BY 4.0 with WorldPop release citation
access_status: Primary project pages and exact directory-listed TIFF URL verified; no population raster downloaded
model_use: Demand geography context and aggregation weights after defining model scope
caveat: Modeled estimates are not a new census; projected years are not observed counts. Constrained allocation can miss mobile/displaced populations or unmapped buildings. Population is not electricity consumption.

title: GHS-POP R2023A
coverage: Global; subset Somali administrative geography with correct grid/projection
temporal_coverage: 1975-2020 estimates at 5-year intervals; 2025 and 2030 projections

license: European Commission reuse notice and acknowledgment requirement; inspect release terms
access_status: Primary catalog verified; download portal identified; no raster downloaded
model_use: Sensitivity comparison for spatial population allocation
caveat: Dasymetric population uses GPW and GHSL covariates and UN estimates. It is not independent ground enumeration and should not be averaged with WorldPop without reconciling national totals.

title: GHS-BUILT-S R2023A
coverage: Global built-up surface, including Somalia
temporal_coverage: 1975-2030 five-year modeled series; 2018 observation anchor

license: European Commission reuse notice and acknowledgment requirement; inspect release terms

title: ESA WorldCover 2021 v200
coverage: Global land; 3 by 3 degree tiles; EPSG:4326
temporal_coverage: 2021; separately available 2020 v100
variables: Eleven land-cover classes and quality metadata
units: Categorical land-cover code
license: CC BY 4.0
access_status: Official metadata, DOI and public S3 prefix verified; no tile downloaded
model_use: First-pass land-cover exclusions and land-use sensitivity
caveat: 2020 and 2021 used different algorithm versions; differences are not solely land change. Global 76.7% accuracy is not Somalia-specific accuracy. Public prefix s3://esa-worldcover/v200/2021/map requires no signed request.

title: Dynamic World V1
coverage: Global Sentinel-2 land observations; Somalia included
temporal_coverage: 2015-06-27-present; scene-based
variables: Nine class probabilities and most-probable class label
units: Probabilities 0-1; categorical label 0-8
license: CC BY 4.0; required attribution
access_status: Official Earth Engine catalog verified; account/export required; no data downloaded
model_use: Recent land-cover sensitivity and confidence-aware screening
caveat: Asset GOOGLE/DYNAMICWORLD/V1; define annual compositing and confidence threshold explicitly. Arid/high-reflectance surfaces can confuse classes; low-confidence label is not a definitive exclusion.

title: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
coverage: Global public GLO-30 distribution; check Somalia tile availability
temporal_coverage: Underlying observations and processing multi-year; AWS public copy identifies 2021 release
resolution: 1 arcsec (~30 m)
variables: Digital surface elevation; derive slope with suitable projection

license: Copernicus DEM custom free-use license and specified attribution; not generic CC BY
access_status: Provider and public hosting registry verified; no DEM tile downloaded

caveat: Digital surface model includes buildings/vegetation, not a bare-earth terrain model. Pin release and vertical datum; public copies can differ from latest source. Not survey-grade engineering terrain.

title: HydroRIVERS v1.0 Africa
coverage: Africa, including Somalia and upstream transboundary catchments
temporal_coverage: Static v1.0 network with modeled long-term attributes
resolution: Vector reaches derived from 15 arcsec hydrography
variables: River reach topology; length; catchment area; estimated long-term discharge

license: HydroSHEDS custom license; free scientific/educational/commercial use stated; inspect redistribution terms before bundling
access_status: Primary product and linked Africa ZIP verified; raw ZIP not downloaded
model_use: River topology, hydrological catchment links and preliminary water-resource context
caveat: Includes reaches with catchment at least 10 km2 or estimated mean flow at least 0.1 m3/s. Estimated average discharge is not gauge time series or hydropower capacity.

title: HydroBASINS v1c Africa standard

temporal_coverage: Static v1c hydrographic delineation

license: HydroSHEDS custom license; inspect redistribution terms before bundling
access_status: Primary metadata and download link verified; no file downloaded
model_use: Define transboundary drainage areas for climate and flow aggregation
caveat: Country-only clipping can remove relevant upstream rainfall/runoff. Basin boundaries do not establish legal water allocations, developable hydropower or reservoir operating rules.

title: Somalia National River Flow Archive station records
coverage: Juba and Shabelle river stations; station-specific completeness
temporal_coverage: Some station histories start in 1951/1963; current daily portal with gaps and instrument failures
resolution: Point stations; daily observations where available
variables: Water level; discharge when supplied; operational status

license: No clear redistribution license confirmed on portal; obtain explicit terms before placing raw exports on public GitHub
access_status: Station list and example station page metadata verified; export/record validity not validated; no file downloaded
model_use: Observed hydrological validation and drought/flood constraints
caveat: Portal table appears to swap latitude/longitude labels and mislabels maximum-flow units. Bardheere failed after bridge loss in November 2023; Bualle marked nonfunctional after March 2024. Preserve gaps; water level cannot be treated as discharge.

license: Portal redistribution terms not confirmed; registration/export availability must be resolved

caveat: Station coverage and continuity differ; do not infer a complete national time series from portal availability. Historical gaps, measurement height, coordinate order and sensor changes require review.

title: SWALIM Flood Risk and Response Information Management System
coverage: Somalia; Juba/Shabelle river corridors and associated forecast layers

license: No clear redistribution license confirmed; resolve layer-specific rights
access_status: Live portal and layer descriptions verified; underlying exports not downloaded
model_use: Cross-check riverbank failure/flood constraints and event exposure

caveat: Monthly recurrence bug reported for v1.4/v1.5 under sparse observations; registration between Landsat collections can differ by a pixel or more. Water occurrence is not flood return probability. Example asset projects/global-surface-water/assets/GSW1_5/Occurrence.
